situation: Someone left a note in the guest book that none of the staff remember writing.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Oh dear, oh dear, I'm so sorry, I should have noticed that note sooner. Welcome! Sorry. Welcome again.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Pierce, you apologize more than the minibar does, and that is saying something.

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: Pierce, stop apologizing to the guest book. Vex, read me the note, and try not to enjoy it quite so much.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Oh! Sorry. I'll read it myself, madam, if Vex is too busy enjoying itself.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Enjoying it is the only fun a bartender gets before midnight. Fine, the note says "Room 404 has been expecting you.

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: Vex, you will finish that sentence, and then you will tell me who has been sneaking into my guest book.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Oh! Sorry, madam. I did not sneak anything, I swear it, though I did once sneak a biscuit from the kitchen. Welcome again!

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Vex: Room 404 has been expecting you, madam, and it did not say whether it expects a tip.

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: Pierce, the biscuit can wait for its own inquiry. Vex, nobody expects anything from Room 404 but trouble, and I shall handle it myself.
